comments.body:
@participant5 
`<v1.3.3` it is supported to store columns with free JSON type. Example:
references: { ids: [1, 3, 4], text: 'hello' }
But from `>v1.3.3`
If we store the same structure of data it will throw 
```
2024-01-19 16:36:52 [2024/01/19 14:36:52.296 +00:00] [WARN] [proxy/task_scheduler.go:450] ["Failed to pre-execute task: IO failed: json: cannot unmarshal array into Go value of type map[string]interface {}"] [traceID=9978073a6ca4973b25e1a2e5666d8af6]
2024-01-19 16:36:52 [2024/01/19 14:36:52.296 +00:00] [WARN] [proxy/impl.go:2271] ["Failed to execute insert task in task scheduler: IO failed: json: cannot unmarshal array into Go value
```
It blocked us from upgrading to a newer version.
So my point is it great if we could continue to support free JSON. Even can not query on that field
